name: FLA_LEASE_PAYMENT_LINES
description: FLA_LEASE_PAYMENT_LINES contains the payment lines for a lease payment header and retains information such as amount, payment start date, payment end date, and so on.

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Payment Line identifier. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment header identifier. Payment header to which the payment line belongs to.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASES_ALL table to indicate that the payment lines are pertaining to specific lease.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount in the payment currency

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the payment is inactive.

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the payment is active.

columns.name: FIRST_PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: The first payment date for the payment line

columns.name: NO_OF_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Number of payments to happen based on the effective dates and frequency. This should be empty in case the stub flag is set to Yes.

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Payment line number. It is a number sequence unique across the lease payment header

columns.name: STUB_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment line is for one-time payment for specific period or for regular payment.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease and payment data was created.

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Parent record identifier. This identifies the parent record for this record.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of change to the record, whether INSERT or UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_IN_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number in which there was a change, either an Addition or Update or Delete.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated payment amount in the payment currency.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_FUNC_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated payment amount in the functional currency.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FUNC_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount in the functional currency

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: ASSESSABLE_VALUE
columns.description: User-enterable amount to be used as taxable basis. For future use.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_LINE_END_DATE
columns.description: Original end date of the line which will be captured if the line is contracted to an earlier date.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Adjustment type used while doing the adjustment for the line.

columns.name: SOURCE_PAYMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source payment line identifier for the adjustment line.

columns.name: FIRST_RECURRING_START_DATE
columns.description: The earliest recurring payment line start date.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_NUM_OF_PAYMENTS
columns.description: The cumulative number of recurring payments for the payment line.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
